limitations: Targeted explicit-service constraint checks, not an independent general semantic benchmark
Names and capabilities checked against existing descriptors; no live service calls
Negative cases require fallback equality, not successful task execution

cases.zh: 通过baidu-netdisk连接器查找我网盘中的发票文件。
